reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this is the first one I've seen that shows the batch lab report behind a QR code. Bisglycinate with a known 200 mg dose and no oxide is what I would look for anyway, so I'd try one box at the $24.99 launch price.
objection: It's one form of magnesium, and I want to see the actual lab report and the lab's name before I trust it. A brand-new product with zero reviews is also a risk, because I read every review and there are none.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report did not open, did not match the batch number, or came from a lab I could not look up, I would not buy.
